corrections.reason: The Ge'ez section heading reads 'ዘከመ መጠዎሙ እግዚእ ኢየሱስ ለሐዋርያት' (How the Lord Jesus entrusted/gave authority to the Apostles). The wide Ge'ez glyph ጠ and ዎሙ were misread as Amharic መሰጠው.
Canonical Ge'ez gerundive of ወፅአ is ወፂኦሙ (with ኦ, as visible in the triangular loop of the glyph, rather than ዖ).
The numeral ፬ (in በ፬ቱ ማዕዘን, 'in the four corners', glossing Ge'ez በኵለሄ 'everywhere') was misread as ፊ (በፊቱ).
